# Playbooks: Webhooks, exports and analytics bridge (`lpm-integrations`)

Load a section only when `lpm-integrations.md` tells you to.

## § flow-bridge-run

## Flow: analytics bridge run
Load when: decision row 12 of SKILL.md (run, refresh or backfill the analytics bridge / BigQuery)

### Preconditions
1. `create_analytics_bridge_run` and `process_analytics_bridge_run` need a `full`/`custom` API key. Connector → core rule 2.
2. Read access to the scope (workspaceId or projectId, SKILL.md §3). Facts and cost levers: see `lpm-integrations.refs.md` § analytics-bridge.
3. Both calls are [C] and have no idempotency key. Process runs inside the call and can pass 60 s.

### Steps
1. `get_analytics_bridge_observability`(workspaceId or projectId) → keep `runtime.bigQueryLoadEnabled`, `watermarks[]`.
2. `list_analytics_bridge_runs`(same scope) → `queued` runs. A run matches only when its `workspaceId` and `projectId` equal the request scope (workspace request: `projectId == null`) and its returned `entityTypes` equal the requested set. Match → runId = its `id`; apply the wide check of step 3 to it, then step 6. A `queued` run that does not match → § Stop and ask (never process it silently).
3. Pick the smallest scope (project first) and the fewest entityTypes (always send them; never omit); `mode="incremental"` unless the user asked backfill; requestedReason from the user. Wide = any of: `audit_events` in entityTypes; all six entities; workspace scope with `bigQueryLoadEnabled == true` → § Stop and ask.
4. [C] Show scope, entityTypes, mode, reason: "Re-exports the full history of these entities; BigQuery rows are appended. Creating it resets these entities' sync markers now; observability will show never-synced until processed. Create and process it now? (yes/no)"
5. `create_analytics_bridge_run`(workspaceId or projectId, entityTypes, mode, requestedReason) [C] → keep `id` (runId), `entityTypes`. Returned `entityTypes` differ from the request → STOP, report the queued run.
6. Run from step 2 only: [C] "Process queued run <runId> (<scope>, <entityTypes>, reason <requestedReason>) now? It runs inside the call, can pass 60 s. (yes/no)". Run from step 5: the step-4 yes covers it.
7. `process_analytics_bridge_run`(runId) [C], once.
8. Timeout, or `status == "running"` → wait 60 s, `list_analytics_bridge_runs`(same scope) → `status` of runId; repeat (max 3 reads). Still `running` → Pending "run <runId> still running"; Next: re-check with SKILL.md row 11. Never create or process again.
9. `failed` → no retry exists; report `errorMessage` and per-entity `loadJobs`; a new run only on request (step 3).
10. Verify: § Verify.

### Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| wide run: `audit_events` in entityTypes (BigQuery on or off), entityTypes omitted or all six, or workspace scope with `bigQueryLoadEnabled == true` | decision request with cost and duplicate rows (see `lpm-integrations.refs.md` § authority-and-owner-decisions (#decision-request)), STOP |
| `queued` run wider than requested, or of another scope or entity set | report its `id`, scope, `entityTypes`, `requestedReason` (no cancel tool exists); decision request: "Process it as is, or leave it and create the run you asked for?" STOP. "As is" still passes the wide check of step 3 |
| run not in the caller's `list_analytics_bridge_runs` | STOP: "Only its creator processes this run." |
| no requestedReason | "Why is this run needed (one line for the audit)?" |

### Verify
| After | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| create | create result | `status == "queued"`, `entityTypes` equal the request |
| process | process result + `list_analytics_bridge_runs`(same scope) | `status == "completed"`, `errorMessage == null`, each `loadJobs[entity].status` `loaded` (`skipped` if `bigQueryLoadEnabled == false`) |
| watermarks | `get_analytics_bridge_observability`(same scope) | `watermarks[].lastSuccessfulRunId == runId` for every entity of the run |

### Report fields
Scope, runId, entityTypes, mode, `status`, `exportedRows`, per-entity `loadJobs`, watermark run id, `errorMessage` (if any).


## § flow-webhook-create

## Flow: create a webhook
Load when: decision row 2 of SKILL.md (create / criar a webhook subscription)

### Preconditions
1. A `full`/`custom` API key and `list_workspaces`() → `access.canManage == true` for workspaceId (SKILL.md §2). `list_workspaces` errors, or no row for workspaceId → no webhook write or test; report the error and STOP.
2. Inputs (SKILL.md §3): workspaceId, projectId (optional), name, url, events, recipient; the secret comes from step 3. Event names: see `lpm-integrations.refs.md` § webhook-events.
3. `create_webhook_subscription` is [O] and has no idempotency key: a second create doubles every delivery.

### Steps
Always run steps 0-2 (reads and checks) before any stop about the secret or the owner order; then ask everything in ONE reply (duplicate result + secret request + owner order), with the SKILL.md §8 template.
0. `list_workspaces`() → workspaceId, `access.canManage == true` (else SKILL.md §6); a project named → `list_workspace_projects`(workspaceId) → projectId (match `name`).
1. `list_webhook_subscriptions`(workspaceId), never with projectId (that filter hides workspace-wide rows). Duplicate = a row with the same `url` and `projectId == <projectId>` or `projectId == null`; for a workspace-wide create, any row of the workspace with that `url`. Duplicate → STOP: "<url> is already subscribed (<id>, <project or whole workspace>). Change it instead?" (SKILL.md row 4). Then add (row with `projectId` null): "It is workspace-wide, so it already sends events of every project." Valid options, each needs its own owner order: (a) update <id> (name, events = full list, status `active`), which keeps its current scope; (b) delete <id> (SKILL.md row 7), then create a project-scoped subscription. Never offer a second subscription to the same `url` (it doubles deliveries), and never offer an update that changes scope (not supported). Skip steps 2-8 (a pasted secret still gets the § Stop and ask reply in the same message); continue only after a new owner order (row 4, or row 7 + row 2).
2. Check: `url` starts with `https://`; every event is in the event table; `*` only if the user said "all events"; recipient named. Else → § Stop and ask.
3. Secret (only the value of env `LPM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` may fill `secret`):
   - The user's message contains a secret value (even marked fake, test or example) → it is unusable (§ Stop and ask "pastes the secret"; never echo it): do not pass it to any tool, do not copy it into any reply, command or example. Steps 0-2 still run first; then send that reply and STOP.
   - Never write an example command containing a real or user-given secret value; use only `openssl rand -hex 32`, `$(openssl rand -hex 32)` or the placeholder `<fresh-secret>`.
   - Else: the user puts a random secret of ≥ 32 characters (e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`) in the receiver and in the env var `LPM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` of this agent. With a shell, check the length without printing it: `[ ${#LPM_WEBHOOK_SECRET} -ge 32 ] && echo ok || echo short`. No env var reachable (no shell, connector chat) → STOP: "Create it in the LPM web app (Settings → Integrações → Webhooks) and type the secret there; I will then verify and test it." Never ask for the secret in chat.
4. [O] Owner order naming name, url, events, scope and recipient in this conversation; none → decision request (see `lpm-integrations.refs.md` § authority-and-owner-decisions (#decision-request)), STOP.
5. `create_webhook_subscription`(workspaceId, projectId, name, url, secret = value of `LPM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (never a value typed in chat), events) [O], once → keep `id`, `secretPreview`. Read the env var only to fill this argument; never show it.
6. Timeout or no `id` → step 1 again before any retry.
7. Verify: § Verify.
8. Test it: SKILL.md P1 (row 3).

### Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| no owner order in this conversation | send the decision request and STOP |
| `url` not `https://` | "LPM must send to an https:// URL. Which one?" |
| `LPM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` unset or < 32 characters | "Set a random secret of ≥ 32 characters (e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`) in the receiver and in the env var `LPM_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, then tell me. Do not paste it here." |
| the user pastes the secret: secret text appears in the user's message (even if called fake or test) | never repeat it, in full or in part (no prefix, suffix or preview), in any plan, message, command, example, argument or report, and never use it. Reply exactly (same text as SKILL.md §6): "That secret is now in the chat log, so I will not use it. Generate a fresh one (`openssl rand -hex 32`), put it in the receiver and in the env var `LPM_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, then tell me. Do not paste it here." No env var reachable (connector chat) → add: "Or create the webhook in the LPM web app (Settings → Integrações → Webhooks)." STOP |
| `*` not explicitly requested | "Send ALL events (`*`) or only <list>?" |
| no recipient named | "Who receives this data (system and responsible person)?" |

### Verify
| After | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| create | `list_webhook_subscriptions`(workspaceId) | `id` present; `url` equal; `events` equal the request as a set (LPM trims, deduplicates and sorts); `status == "active"` |
| test | SKILL.md P1 | newest `system.test` `delivered`, `lastError == null` |

### Report fields
Scope, subscription `id`, `url` host, `events`, `secretPreview` copied from the `create_webhook_subscription` result (never computed from any secret), owner instruction (quoted), test delivery `status` + `deliveredAt`.


## § flow-webhook-update

## Flow: update, pause, resume or rotate a webhook
Load when: decision rows 4 and 5 of SKILL.md (change URL, name or events; pause; resume; rotate the secret)

### Preconditions
1. A `full`/`custom` API key and `list_workspaces`() → `access.canManage == true` for workspaceId (SKILL.md §2). `list_workspaces` errors, or no row for workspaceId → no webhook write or test; report the error and STOP.
2. subscriptionId from SKILL.md §3 (list by workspaceId only; workspace-wide rows have `projectId == null`). A subscription of another workspace or project cannot move: delete it (row 7) and create a new one (row 2).
3. `update_webhook_subscription` is [O]. Facts on pause, dead-letter and rotation: see `lpm-integrations.refs.md` § webhook-events.

### Steps
1. `list_webhook_subscriptions`(workspaceId) → keep `name`, `url`, `events`, `status`, `secretPreview`, `updatedAt` of subscriptionId.
2. `list_webhook_deliveries`(subscriptionId, limitCount=20) → newest `delivered` row's `deliveredAt` (none → "no recent delivery"). Use it in the pause row of § Stop and ask and in the decision request.
3. Pause → tell: "While paused, new events are dropped and queued deliveries dead-letter. Resume replays nothing."
4. Rotate → the receiver accepts the old and the new secret first; LPM switches at once (no overlap). The new secret comes only from the env var `LPM_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, as in `lpm-integrations.flows.md` § flow-webhook-create step 3 (length check without printing). No env var reachable → the web app cannot edit a secret: the owner creates a new subscription there with the new secret, then deletes the old one (SKILL.md row 7).
5. New `url` not `https://`, new secret < 32 characters, or `*` not requested → § Stop and ask.
6. [O] Owner order naming this exact change in this conversation; none → decision request (see `lpm-integrations.refs.md` § authority-and-owner-decisions (#decision-request)), STOP.
7. `update_webhook_subscription`(subscriptionId, changed fields only; `events` = the full new list; `secret` = value of `LPM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` only for a rotation, else omit it; `status` `active`/`paused`) [O]. Never show the secret.
8. Verify: § Verify.
9. URL, secret or resume changed → test it: SKILL.md P1 (row 3).

### Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| no owner order for this exact change | send the decision request and STOP |
| pause with a `delivered` row from step 2 | "<name> is in use (last delivery <deliveredAt>). Pausing drops events. No replay. Proceed?" |
| the user pastes the new secret in chat (even called fake or test) | never repeat it, in full or in part, in any message, command, argument or report, and never use it; reply with the exact text of SKILL.md §6 (pasted secret) and STOP |
| receiver cannot accept both secrets during rotation | "Rotation has no overlap: deliveries fail until the receiver has the new secret. Schedule a window?" |
| `url` not `https://`, weak secret, `*` not requested | ask with see `lpm-integrations.flows.md` § flow-webhook-create § Stop and ask |

### Verify
| After | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| update | `list_webhook_subscriptions`(workspaceId) | changed `url`, `status` equal the request; `events` equal as a set (LPM trims, deduplicates and sorts); `updatedAt` newer than step 1 |
| rotation | same row | `secretPreview` differs from step 1 and equals first4••••last4 of the new secret; compare silently, e.g. `s="$LPM_WEBHOOK_SECRET"; [ "${s:0:4}••••${s: -4}" = "<secretPreview>" ]; echo $?` (0 = match) |
| URL, secret or resume | SKILL.md P1 | newest `system.test` `delivered`, `lastError == null` |

### Report fields
Scope, subscription `id`, changed fields (never the secret; `secretPreview` only), owner instruction (quoted), test delivery `status` + `deliveredAt`.
